paper.title: A multi-adjuvant personal neoantigen vaccine generates potent immunity in melanoma
paper.authors: Blass, Keskin, Ott, Wu et al.
paper.source_note: Aggregates derived from Cell supplemental Data S1–S5 (de-identified patient IDs P101–P111). Not clinical care data.

notes: Full ex vivo clonotype tables (>300k rows/patient) are not retained; category counts + top post-vaccine clones are stored.
IMP-expanded clones are those marked highly expanded in vitro vs DMSO.
